The structure of NdZn3 is tetragonal with space group P4_2/mnm (No. 143) and a unit cell containing 8 atoms (Nd2Zn6). Its two independent Wyckoff orbits are Nd and Zn, with four unit-cell atoms each. Geometry-derived analysis shows both Nd and Zn centers with 12 geometric neighbors in close-packed-like local arrangements; Nd is surrounded by 12 Zn neighbors, while Zn has 4 Nd and 8 Zn neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component. Validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among 12-vertex Zn-centered polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between Nd- and Zn-centered polyhedra.
